newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO SIGN STRIKER LUIZAO AS SIXTH BRAZILIAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO SIGN STRIKER LUIZAO AS SIXTH BRAZILIAN.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna have signed Brazilian striker Luizao from Palmeiras, in a deal thought to be worth around 700 million pesetas ($4.86 million).
But Deportivo have ensured their new signing against poachers by putting at seven billion pesetas ($48.6 million) the amount to be paid by any club wanting to buy Luizao.
Luizao's 'cancellation clause' is the second-highest in the multi-billion peseta Spanish league, after that of Real Madrid teenager Raul Gonzalez.
"(He's) a bet for the present and the future," said Deportivo president Lendoiro.
Luizao will join fellow Brazilians Rivaldo, Renaldo, Mauro Silva, Donato and Flavio Conceicao at Deportivo, who are currently in third place in the Spanish first division.

The La Coruna side has been a favoured destination for Brazilians since the arrival of World Cup striker Bebeto in 1992. The local Galician language spoken in the city is similar to the Brazilians' native tongue, Portuguese.
